```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```

# import

```{r Intro}
rm(list=ls())
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_pre_processed.Rdata")
lm0 <- glm(goal_YN~.,dat=dat_cleaned, family=binomial)

threshold <- 0.3
p_lm0 <- predict(lm0, newdata=dat_test %>% dplyr::select(!goal_YN),
                 type="response")
Fitted_goal <- ifelse(p_lm0 >= threshold, 1, 0)
cm_f <- caret::confusionMatrix(data=as.factor(Fitted_goal), reference=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN))
cm_f
```

# xg di statbomb

```{r Intro}
library(pROC)
roc(response=dat_test$goal_YN, predictor=p_lm0) %>% plot(print.auc=T)
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test_full.Rdata")
roc(response=dat_test$goal_YN, predictor=dat_test$shot_statsbomb_xg) %>% plot(print.auc=T)

tibble(t=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
        e=factor(ifelse(dat_test$shot_statsbomb_xg>0.3,1,0), levels=c(0,1))) %>%
      yardstick::f_meas(truth=t, estimate=e, event_level = "second")

tibble(t=as.factor(dat_test$goal_YN),
        e=factor(ifelse(p_lm0>0.188,1,0), levels=c(0,1))) %>%
      yardstick::f_meas(truth=t, estimate=e, event_level = "second")
```

# Classifica

```{r import_classifica}
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test_full.Rdata")
glimpse(dat_test)

matches_res <- read_csv("../creazione_dataset/games_results/serieA_2015_16_games_results.csv")
glimpse(matches_res)
```

Credo un dataframe con i dati delle partite che mi interessano

```{r dati_sulle_partite}
matches_res <- matches_res %>% dplyr::select(match_id, home_team, away_team, home_score, away_score, match_week)

pred <- p_lm0
```

Credo un dataframe con i dati dei tiri che mi interessano

```{r dati_sui_tiri}
df <- dat_test %>% dplyr::select(match_id, player, player_id, team, team_id, goal_YN) %>% mutate(my_xg = pred)
```

Li unisco

```{r}
df <- left_join(df, matches_res, by=join_by(match_id==match_id))
df <- df %>% mutate(my_xg = pred)
```

Faccio MC

```{r MC}
B <- 10000
MC <- matrix(0, nrow=760, ncol=B+2)

MC[,1] <- rep(unique(df$match_id), each=2)

i=1 # indice di riga
for (match in unique(df$match_id)){
  sub_df = df[df$match_id==match,]
  for (team in unique(sub_df$team)){
    MC[i,2] <- team
    sub_sub_df = sub_df[sub_df$team==team,]
    MC[i,3:(B+2)] = replicate(B, sum( rbinom( length (sub_sub_df$my_xg), size=1, prob=sub_sub_df$my_xg) ) )
    i = i + 1
  }
}
```

Trovo gli xP

```{r xP}
g_results <- matrix(0, nrow=760, ncol=B+2)
g_results[,1:2] <- MC[,1:2]

for (col_index in 3:(B+2)){
  for (row_index in seq(1, 760, by=2)){
    score1 <- MC[row_index,col_index]
    score2 <- MC[row_index+1,col_index]
    if (score1 > score2){
      g_results[row_index:(row_index+1),col_index] = c(3,0) }
    else if (score1 < score2){
      g_results[row_index:(row_index+1),col_index] = c(0,3) }
    else{
      g_results[row_index:(row_index+1),col_index] = c(1,1)}
  }
}

xP <- matrix(0, 760, 3)
xP[,1:2] <- g_results[,1:2]
xP[,3] <- apply(g_results[,3:(B+2)], 1, function(x) mean(as.numeric(x)) )

apply(g_results[g_results[,1]==3879548,3:(B+2)],2,function(x) x[1] > x[2]) %>% table()/B
apply(g_results[g_results[,1]==3879548,3:(B+2)],2,function(x) x[1] < x[2]) %>% table()/B
apply(g_results[g_results[,1]==3879548,3:(B+2)],2,function(x) x[1] == x[2]) %>% table()/B

colnames(xP) <- c("match_id", "team_id", "xP")
xP <- xP %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(match_id = as.factor(match_id),
         team_id = as.factor(team_id),
         xP = as.numeric(xP))

xP %>% as.data.frame() %>% filter(match_id=="3879548")
```

Aggrego gli xP e faccio la league table

```{r league_table}
league_table <- xP %>% group_by(team_id) %>% 
  summarise(xP_tot = sum(xP))

real_table <- read_table("../creazione_dataset/serieA_2015_16_real_table.txt")

#real_table <- real_table %>% arrange(SQUADRA) %>% 
#  mutate(id=101:120)
#league_table <- league_table %>% arrange(team_id) %>% 
#  mutate(id=101:120)

real_table <- real_table %>% arrange(-PUNTI)
league_table <- league_table %>% arrange(-xP_tot)

xg_tot = df %>% group_by(team) %>% summarise(xG_tot = sum(my_xg))

league_table <- left_join(league_table, xg_tot,
                by=join_by(team_id == team))


View(cbind(league_table,
           real_table))
```

# differenza xg vs g per squadra

```{r}
goal_table <- left_join(real_table %>% dplyr::select(SQUADRA,GF),
                        xg_tot,
                by=join_by(SQUADRA == team)) %>% 
  mutate(GF=GF %>% as.numeric(),
         xG_tot=xG_tot %>% as.numeric()) %>% 
  mutate(xG_diff = GF - xG_tot)
```
